lines: The sounds of sirens were audible.
It looked like somebody had reported it.
But he didn't care about things like that.
Saitou had moved away from the downtown street, which was in a state of panic, and taken refuge in a dilapidated building.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Good. If I'm here―――Uuhh...」
He rested his back on a pillar of the crumbling building.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Haah haah haah......」
It was getting tough to remain standing.
It seemed that he had lost too much blood before reaching this place.
Saitou Hanjirou
「......Uuh...... The abdominal bleeding is serious. I have to stop the blood quickly...... Haah haah...」
Of course, he had brought tools for that.
He could perform not only first aid, but, if he felt like it, even simple surgeries.
He was about to take those out, when
Igawa Kageomi
『I know you fled in here!!!』
That aggravating man's voice echoed in the ruined building.
Saitou Hanjirou
「Tch.」
Igawa Kageomi
『What's wrong, serial killer? I'd've thought you'd be fine with dragging ordinary people into this, but you've got a soft side too, huh?』
He seemed to be referring to the fact that Saitou had come to this ruined building.
Saitou Hanjirou
「How asinine.」
Ordinary people did not exist in this world.
There were only the chosen ubermensch like himself, highborn for providing the ubermensch with the pleasure of murder, and herde to be culled.
Why would he ever concern himself with the lives of those slaves in human form?
There were three reasons why he had come here.
To treat his wound.
To ensure his ninja art wasn't seen.
And, to take care of Igawa Kageomi, who was bound to brazenly come along.
Igawa Kageomi
『No answer, huh? Well, I don't mind, though. My assassination squad's got you completely surrounded.』
Igawa Kageomi
「You're finished.」
Kageomi monologued.
He didn't know what Saitou intended to do, coming to a place like this, but he had figured out how to fight him.
Now it was time to finish up this job.
He would just kill him as usual.
Simply, and certainly.
Igawa Kageomi
「Go.」
Kageomi ordered the assassination squad.
